name: Input
summary: A single line text input: a native input in a bordered box with optional start and end adornments, or a plain field with no box for a row of a grouped card. On web a bordered box; on ios a gray rounded field, or a plain row of an inset group with a round clear button; on android Material's filled field.
useWhen: A short value typed on one line: a name, an email, a link, a number
A search box, with the search icon at the start
A value with a unit or a currency shown inside the box
avoidWhen: A choice from a known list
A date, a color or a file

size.description: Height from size.control: 24, 28, 32 and 44 px at default density.

shape.description: default takes radius.control from the style, a pill in Studio and Desk. pill is always fully round.

invalid.description: Marks the value invalid. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

disabled.description: Inside a Field it follows the Field.

readOnly.description: Still focusable, selectable and readable. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

required.description: Sets aria-required. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

start.description: An icon name, a short text such as $, or a node. Icon names and texts are aria-hidden.

end.description: An icon name, a short text such as px, or a node. Icon names and texts are aria-hidden.

rootProps.description: Props for the root box. className and style also go to the root; every other native prop and the ref go to the input.

variant.description: outlined: a border all round. filled: a tinted box. plain: no box, no border and no fill, for a row of an inset Fieldset, where the row hairline and the card edge show the field. Stamped as data-variant only when passed, so a style or platform can follow it.

clearable.description: Adds the clear part: a CloseButton that shows while the field has a value and focus, clears the value and moves focus back to the input. Escape clears too, except inside a dialog.

clearLabel.description: The accessible name of the clear button. Default Clear text, or مسح النص under an Arabic Theme.

a11y.role: textbox, from the native input (spinbutton for type number, searchbox for type search)
a11y.focus: The input is the tab stop. Clicking anywhere in the box that is not interactive focuses the input. Focus shows the glow and a 2px ring around the box; a plain field shows the ring alone. With clearable, the clear button is a second tab stop after the input, only while it shows.

keys.Tab: Moves focus to the input, and on to the next control
keys.Home, End: Move the caret to the start or the end of the value
keys.ArrowUp, ArrowDown: Change the value for type number
keys.Escape: Clears the value for type search, as the browser does. With clearable, clears the value when the field is not inside a dialog; inside a dialog Escape closes the dialog.
keys.Enter, Space: On the clear button: clears the value and moves focus back to the input

a11y.announce: Name from the Field label. The Field description and error through aria-describedby. aria-invalid and aria-required from the Field.
notes: No native title attribute. Use Tooltip for a hint, or the Field description.
dir auto is not set: the value follows the page direction, so a field does not jump sides while someone types a Latin word into Arabic. Pass dir auto yourself for free text in a mixed language form.
Email, url, tel and number values always run left to right, and stay on the reading side of the form. Their placeholder runs in the page direction.
A long value scrolls inside the box. It is never cut with an ellipsis.
Read only looks different from disabled: a dashed border and a quiet fill, full contrast text, and it stays focusable.
Validate on blur or on submit, never on every key. On submit, move focus to the first invalid control.
Disabled uses native disabled and draws with opacity.disabled, like every control.
A value being checked shows the loader icon in the end slot for now. A Spinner arrives in wave 1 and replaces it.

The clear button is named Clear text (مسح النص). It shows only while the box holds focus and a value, so it never sits in the tab order of an empty field. A pointer press on it keeps focus on the input.
A plain field has no boundary of its own (WCAG 1.4.11): use it in a row of an inset Fieldset, whose hairlines and card edge show it, and whose focus ring shows the field in use.
data-empty is present while the value is empty, for a style or platform that draws the empty field differently.

en.label: Always a visible Field label, a noun in sentence case. aria-label only for a toolbar search box.
en.placeholder: An example value at most: For example, spring launch. Never the label, never an instruction the person needs after typing.
en.adornment: A unit or a currency the value is in: px, USD. Never words the label needs. No icon that only decorates, such as a paper plane on an email field.
en.clear: The clear button's name is Clear text. Name what it clears only when two fields in a row are clearable: Clear email.

ar.label: عنوان ظاهر دايم، بصيغة الاسم وبدون تشكيل
ar.placeholder: مثال على القيمة بس، مو بديل عن العنوان
ar.latin: البريد والروابط والأرقام تنكتب من اليسار لليمين حتى داخل العربي

react.note: Motion: fade. The focus glow fades (an opacity transition in Input.css), and the clear button fades in when it shows (@starting-style).

angular.behavior: div[dsInput] around a native input, ControlValueAccessor
angular.note: The host box is the root. React spreads native props on the inner input; Angular cannot forward attributes, so the native props are inputs with the React names (type, placeholder, value as a model, id, name, autoComplete, inputMode, aria-label, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby and more). defaultValue is value. start and end take an icon name, a short text or a TemplateRef. Works with ngModel, formControl and formControlName. Order M9.1: variant plain, clearable with the clear part (a dsCloseButton between the control and the end slot, shown while the box holds focus and a value; a press keeps focus on the input, then clears with an input event; Escape clears except inside a dialog), clearLabel, and data-empty on the root, as React.

styles.studio: Bordered transparent pill, the control border, a soft inner glow and the 2px achromatic ring on focus
styles.desk: The same pill and glow, in Instrument Sans
styles.web: The bordered box of the active style. plain draws no box; it sits in a row of an inset Fieldset card.
styles.ios: A gray rounded field 44 tall with text at 17. plain is a row of an inset group: no box, a round clear button at the trailing end while editing (paint by the platform look order M9.5, proposed).
styles.android: Material's filled field with its indicator line, outlined when variant outlined; plain is drawn as the filled field in a stack of rows (paint by order M9.5, proposed).

mistakes.wrong: A placeholder as the only label
An input with a title attribute for the hint
A disabled input to show a value that cannot change
mistakes.right: readOnly, which stays readable and focusable

mistakes.wrong: dir auto on every input in an Arabic form
mistakes.right: No dir: email, url, tel and number run left to right through the CSS

mistakes.wrong: type date or checkbox on Input
A plain Input on its own on a page, with nothing to show where it is
mistakes.right: A plain Input in a row of a Fieldset with variant inset, or an outlined or filled Input

mistakes.wrong: A clear button built from an IconButton in the end slot
mistakes.right: clearable, which shows the clear part only while it can act and returns focus to the input
